changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO assortment_group_room_types (assortment_group_id, room_type_id) SELECT g.id, rt.id FROM assortment_groups g JOIN room_types rt ON rt.code IN ('kuchnia', 'lazienka') WHERE g.name_pl = 'Sanitariat' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assortment_group_room_types x WHERE x.assortment_group_id = g.id AND x.room_type_id = rt.id );

INSERT INTO assortment_group_room_types (assortment_group_id, room_type_id) SELECT g.id, rt.id FROM assortment_groups g JOIN room_types rt ON rt.code IN ('kuchnia', 'lazienka') WHERE g.name_pl = 'Płytki' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assortment_group_room_types x WHERE x.assortment_group_id = g.id AND x.room_type_id = rt.id );

INSERT INTO assortment_group_room_types (assortment_group_id, room_type_id) SELECT g.id, rt.id FROM assortment_groups g JOIN room_types rt ON rt.code IN ('przedpokoj', 'hol', 'salon', 'biuro', 'master', 'pokoj') WHERE g.name_pl = 'Podłoga' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assortment_group_room_types x WHERE x.assortment_group_id = g.id AND x.room_type_id = rt.id );

INSERT INTO assortment_group_room_types (assortment_group_id, room_type_id) SELECT g.id, rt.id FROM assortment_groups g JOIN room_types rt ON rt.code IN ('przedpokoj', 'hol', 'kuchnia', 'salon', 'biuro', 'master', 'pokoj', 'lazienka') WHERE g.name_pl = 'Drzwi' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assortment_group_room_types x WHERE x.assortment_group_id = g.id AND x.room_type_id = rt.id );
